Three of the nine contributions are from the candidate herself. PRIVACY: the mailing-address column is blank or erased on eight of the nine rows; the one surviving address (Knight Construction) printed a street plus 'SLC, UT 84106' and only the city/state were recorded. The form's own typo 'Disclosure Statemnts' is kept verbatim.
